workflow.reason: New governance panels, a History tab and a lineage view are added inside the accepted master (issues #107-#116); MASTER.md is the visual-system constraint and is not re-persisted.
workflow.first_value: Opening Monitor shows the tenant's live epsilon ledger and the audit-chain verdict before any run.
workflow.efficacy_moment: After a Full Run the ledger's spent epsilon and the chain's record count change, and History lists the new run id.

risk.rationale: Inherits ml-monitoring.json: representing audit integrity, policy control or privacy spend falsely would assert controls that do not exist; the panels also expose destructive admin actions (policy removal, budget reset).

brief.actor: Python data or ML developer (P-001) and the contest reviewer watching the demo
brief.context: xazz-server exposes /runs, /security/audit/*, /security/policy*, /dp/budget*, /catalog and /schema; the IDE called five endpoints only (#104).
brief.job_or_motivation: Show that a pipeline run is governed: what ran, under which policy, what privacy it spent, and that the record was not altered.
brief.observed_problem: Server capabilities had no screen, so the security story could not be demonstrated; runs could not be reopened; the run overlay could not tell slow from stuck.
brief.desired_user_outcome: Reopen a past run, see the live ledger, verify the audit chain and manage the policy pack, each value labelled with its source.
brief.desired_service_outcome: The #154 demo covers check, block, run, budget, audit and lineage inside the IDE.
success_criteria: Every new panel renders loading, offline, error, empty and ready from the real server response.
A tampered audit.jsonl renders Integrity: Mismatch and names the first bad record.
Nothing the server does not return is shown as measured.

problem.statement: The IDE could not show the governance evidence xazz-server already records, so a reviewer could not see what ran, under which policy, at what privacy cost, or whether the record changed.
problem.omission_reason: No new service handoff or owner; panels read existing server contracts.

evidence.summary: visual-ide used five of the server's endpoints; run history, audit log, policy packs and DP budget had no screen.
/execute is synchronous and streams nothing; the run row is written after the process exits.
A request dropped by the client leaves no run row and no audit record although the process ran.
/schema rejected any upload above 2 MB before its own 50 MB check (axum default body limit).
MLflow, Sigstore Rekor, Marquez, Styra DAS and Snowflake DP reference flows.

pain_points.statement: The governance story cannot be demonstrated from the IDE.

insights.statement: Records to look up read best as lists with a detail next to the evidence they explain.

hmw.statement: How might a reviewer verify a run's governance without leaving the workspace?

selected_solutions.statement: Governance section in Monitor, History tab in the dock, lineage in the inspector.

tests.statement: visual-ide/tests/governance.spec.mjs (24 e2e) and tests/auditChain.mjs against a real server fixture.

kpis.statement: Reviewer can name, for each governance value, whether the server measured it.

journey.failure: User reloads and loses the result
journey.recovery: Browser-measured elapsed time and lifecycle; Stop waiting states the dropped request is not recorded

journey.goal: See policy, privacy and audit state
journey.recovery: Offline and error states with the server's own message and Retry

journey.goal: Show the receipt of an earlier run
journey.friction: Only the last run was visible
journey.recovery: 404 shown as not found for this tenant

blueprint.frontstage: Audit chain panel verdict and record table
blueprint.recovery: Integrity: Mismatch with the first failing record from a browser replay
blueprint.metric: Tampered records located by the replay / tampered records

considered.summary: Governance section inside Monitor plus a History tab in the dock and lineage in the inspector
A sixth top-level Governance canvas view

selection_criteria: Keeps each record next to the evidence it explains
Fits the demo path through Monitor

rejected_reasons.reason: Splits what the run did from what the tenant allows and adds a view to learn

alternatives.remaining_uncertainty: Whether a longer Monitor scroll hides the governance section from first-time users.

prototype.unknown: Whether reviewers read server-measured governance values as distinct from run-local reports.

prototype.success_criterion: Participant names the source of each governance value
